## Fixes

- **One loading screen.** Starting a game no longer switches from the artwork to a grey screen. The game's background stays on screen the whole time, dimmed, with the system spinner and the live status text (e.g. "Starting…", "RTSP handshake in progress…"). The art fades out when the video starts.
- **Library PC picker** no longer shows two glass layers: on iOS 26 it uses the navigation bar's own Liquid Glass. The Library title no longer repeats the PC name.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
